channel.title: RMTT News & Articles
channel.description: News and articles from Riddhi Machine Tool Technology.

item.title: Precision cutting tools, made in Bengaluru
item.description: Founded in 2013, RMTT manufactures solid carbide and PCD special tools on a 5-axis CNC grinding cell at our Kanakapura Road facility.

item.title: Why 5-axis CNC tool grinding matters
item.description: Grinding the full tool geometry in one clamping keeps runout consistent and makes complex forms practical.

item.title: PCD reamers with internal coolant
item.description: Solid carbide bodies with brazed PCD cutting edges, built for stable, high-volume machining of aluminium and non-ferrous parts.

item.title: One tool, many operations: step drills and hole mills
item.description: Special drills, step tools and hole mills combine drilling, chamfering and counterboring in a single solid carbide tool.

item.title: Polished end mills for aluminium
item.description: Polished flutes reduce built-up edge and help chips clear, so aluminium parts come off the machine with a better finish.

item.title: Brazed carbide T-slot cutters
item.description: Carbide cutting edges on a tough steel shank, for slot milling where HSS cutters limit speed and tool life.

item.title: The right interface: precision tool holding
item.description: Pairing our special tools with precision holders and collets so the whole tool system performs.

item.title: Welcoming our new VOLLMER EDM machine
item.description: We are happy to welcome our new VOLLMER EDM machine to the Riddhi family, strengthening our precision manufacturing capabilities.
